title: Share the paired residue sampler bank in 84,578 bytes (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite certificate with a scoped minimality proof: share zxv's PR #6072 paired denominator-13 forward graphs while preserving every ordered coin tape's output and first stopping depth.

```diff
- 44,928 internal states; 101,088 bytes for 144 separate resident tables
+ 22,482 internal states; 84,578 bytes including all 144 entry pointers
```

The new quotient saves 16,510 payload bytes. Its state count is minimal for those fixed ordered-coin functions when all residual information is in the counted controller state. Moore minimization is classical; this exact quotient, complete certificate and packed-bank construction are the contribution. The graph definition, sampling law, expected-bit optimum and sharing question remain credited to zxv. Produced by Nick Petalas.

Only `research/shared-residue-dispatcher/` is added. The graph is specified and reconstructed locally, so replay needs neither pending Git objects nor predecessor imports. Canonical main and overlap were refreshed at `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19241707).

## Evidence

- Before: PR #6072 stores 312 internal states and 702 packed bytes per configuration. The comparison here is a resident bank of all 144 configurations. Its on-demand single-table alternative still needs only 702 bytes.
- After: a complete homomorphism checks all 89,864 original edges including artificial terminal loops, all entries and output separation. Separately sorted signatures check every refinement split; reachability establishes the scoped state lower bound. The partition stabilizes at depth nine, confirmed at depth ten.
- Exact packing and unpacking give 84,308 transition bytes plus 270 entry bytes. All 36,864 eight-coin tape controls agree, and five semantic certificate corruptions are rejected.
- CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64: both warning-strict registered modes pass, timed locally at 0.358 s normal and 0.356 s optimized. The direct verifier also passes and generates a source-hash-bound receipt outside the checkout.
- Package metadata, committed bytes, source ancestry, file modes and export integrity/input coverage pass. Read-only Git-free normal and optimized export replays pass with all eight export files unchanged.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-residue-dispatcher
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/shared-residue-dispatcher --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/shared-residue-dispatcher/verify.py
```

Expected `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` and `PASS_SHARED_RESIDUE_DISPATCHER`. Elsewhere, substitute a local CPython 3.12 executable. README.md gives optional packed-bank emission and receipt commands; PROOF.md gives the self-contained graph and proof.

## Limitations

This is a forward logical inventory improvement. The state minimum fixes output order and every coin-tape function; it is not a ROM byte minimum or an optimum over all samplers with the same probability law. A parameter oracle or extra uncounted state is outside the model. Interpreter/header costs are omitted on both sides.

Physical selection, lookup, random-tape movement, stopping records, reversible cleanup, native/caller integration and their full bill remain open. The quotient does not transfer PR #6102's predecessor-uniqueness condition. No bounded stopping time, runtime speedup, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Physical/native, selected scientific and formal proof-kernel replays were not run; all five framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

- Price one actual nonadaptive caller's selection, packed lookup, outputs and tape movement against on-demand table generation.
- Determine the retained discriminator and cleanup bill needed for reversible use of a merged residual state.

## Related open work

- #6072, zxv, `9011bf83e85ecd0443c789cf03259442f750877d`: defines the 144 ordered-coin graphs and asks about sharing. This builds a new shared bank, with the same inherited per-configuration behavior and unchanged expected draws.
- #6068, zxv, `689e28282fd5259dec7f75b83904617dab2d7b3a`: bounds finite-cap sampling choices. This retains unbounded stopping and claims no new bias/abort tradeoff.
- #6096, JoyboyBrian: identifies actual inverse residues and a conditional selector adapter. This improves the logical table inventory only, without implementing or repricing that adapter.
- #6102, JoyboyBrian: reverses the literal (1,1) DDG using a resident transcript and counter. This certifies forward sharing only; its reversal tariff and unique-predecessor premise do not transfer.

- #6127, Nick Petalas: removes the stopping counter for reversal of the original fixed (1,1) DDG using an owned adjacent tape cell. This PR shares forward residual states across configurations; reversal of the shared quotient and transfer of #6127's tariff are not established. No same-quantity numerical comparison is made.

## CI notes

CI is **uncertified** at commit `9ae1d82f4e248dd830e32c4d2a0330b62cddc1dd`. In [run 40692500348](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40692500348), `plan` failed during Onboarding helper tests and the package replay was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI.**

The failure is unrelated to this package and is inherited from main commit `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, which admitted PR6030 with `[skip ci]` and updated the selected record without matching the onboarding documentation:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects the exact marker `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. The document instead bolds `0.003125804 = 781451/250000000` together, so that marker is absent.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in `docs/ci.md`, which still describes #5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

The failed-job log reports 678 tests, two failures and 23 skips. [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027) fails the same two tests, confirmed from its failed-job log. Both check statuses were read once for this PR; no scientific CI success is inferred.

All package checks listed above passed locally, but this hosted run certifies none of them. The PR needs a maintainer re-run after main's documentation is fixed. No new commit or push was made for this inherited failure.

## Merge danger

Two-way change with an isolated research-package scope. Shared implementation, frozen evidence and the selected result are unchanged.
